summary: HSBC Holdings filed a 6-K furnishing a Notice of Redemption Price Determination dated 4 November 2026 for its US$2.25bn 7.390% Fixed/Floating Rate Senior Unsecured Notes due 2028, of which US$1,276,632,000 remains outstanding (CUSIP 404280DR7). The issuer elected a make-whole redemption in whole on 9 November 2026, with the make-whole amount set at US$1,023.55 per US$1,000 principal plus accrued interest from 3 November 2026. This is a routine debt redemption notice, not a special situation; no equity or deal terms arise, and no arbitrage angle applies.
